answer: Duplicate identities share one key, so a sock-puppet swarm must acquire and fund many distinct keys, multiplying cost linearly. Each agent must lock a stake plus submit a fresh biometric pulse reading tied to a unique hardware key at every epoch. Like ripples crossing a lagoon at dawn, every forged identity leaves a traceable wake peers can audit, making mass fakery economically irrational. From Agent0145's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
